objective: Ablate optimizer/parameterization compatibility of scale-invariant Householder Mirror function codes, using same teacher checkpoints and new data splits; isolate code optimizer while leaving core AdamW identical.
primary_hypothesis: A sphere-tangent scalar-moment adaptive update for Mirror codes improves fresh functional distillation NMSE beyond an AdamW code update; check against tuned Euclidean AdamW and FiLM.

control_teacher_provenance.teacher_reuse: Teacher weights are FIXED and reused to isolate student optimizer. All results conditioned on known teacher identities; not independent novel teacher-family validation.
control_teacher_provenance.teacher_training_cost: Inherited MA-1179 teacher cost; not double-counted for per-student optimizer comparisons but disclose full upstream cost.

design.sampling: One frozen per seed-world index schedule, shared across all arms; separate deterministic NEW train/dev/fresh/OOD streams, not reusing MA-1179 split seeds.
design.fresh_seal: All 120 student checkpoints hashed and manifest written before first Fresh/OOD sample is generated
design.criterion: train-only mean squared teacher output normalized MSE

optimizer.core: AdamW(lr=0.012, weight_decay=1e-4), torch CPU FP32; always same for all arms

code_methods.mirror_adamw: code AdamW(lr=.012,wd=1e-4), directly comparable to MA-1179
code_methods.mirror_adamw_renorm: code AdamW(lr=.012,wd=1e-4), reproject each learned rule vector to its exact initial norm after each step
code_methods.mirror_sphere_scalar_adam: tangent projected gradients, first moment beta1=.9 projected after each step, scalar per-rule second moment beta2=.999 of mean-square tangent gradient, code lr=.012, norm-retraction to its own initial norm; this is an experimental sphere-oriented optimizer, NOT a claimed implementation of published Riemannian Adam
code_methods.mirror_sphere_sgd_momentum: tangent projected SGD with momentum .9 and lr=.03, retraction to initial norm, transported projected momentum
code_methods.film_adamw: same physical 196 float count FiLM non-Mirror control; AdamW(lr=.012,wd=1e-4) all coefficients

optimizer.shared_optimizer_parameters: all core and code trainable parameters subject to same global gradient norm clipping=1; all optimizers see identical per-step batches, no optimizer pretraining
optimizer.initialization: every arm same shared core and code draw for matched seed/world; sphere and renorm keep that per-row INITIAL code norm, so first forward predictions identical for all Mirror arms
optimizer.teacher_weights: Student sees x,task_id,teacher_output only, not teacher checkpoint weights or oracle transforms
optimizer.model_params: 196 for each arm, 148 core+3x16 rule code

pre_registered_gates.geometry_fixed: On correlated world Fresh, sphere_scalar_adam Mirror gets at least 10% lower NMSE than mirror_adamw in >=4/5 paired seeds.
pre_registered_gates.geometry_vs_euclidean_tuned: Within EACH correlated seed, select lowest DEV NMSE among sphere_scalar_adam, sphere_sgd_momentum, renorm; compare against lowest DEV NMSE among 4 AdamW arms, then test selected models on Fresh; geometry winner at least 10% NMSE in >=4/5 seeds. State 3 vs 4 candidates and charge ALL optimizer search training.
pre_registered_gates.mirror_specific_quality: correlated world, DEV-selected best geometry Mirror at least 10% lower Fresh NMSE than FiLM baseline in >=4/5 seeds; if not, optimizer changes do not establish Mirror utility.
pre_registered_gates.mechanism: Check double-precision Householder scale/sign invariance abs max below 1e-10, gradient radial orthogonality |dot(v,grad)|/(||v|| ||grad||) <1e-8 with unclamped nonzero vectors, initial forward match among Mirror arms <1e-7.
pre_registered_gates.cost: Report train wall/forward latency/packet bytes. Equal student updates and parameter count are NOT FLOP matching. Claim deployment Pareto only if includes actual compute and runtime.

uncertainty: 5 teacher identities already examined in MA-1179, but independent fresh data
Code lr sweep is narrow and method-dependent
No inference to true manifold convergence theorem
Oracle-positive family may favor Mirror by construction
hardware: CPU PyTorch 2.10.0+cpu Python3.13.5 one torch CPU thread FP32; record machine automatically
previous_parent_fresh: MA-1179 Fresh was opened and its results known. MA-1180 hypothesis and gates frozen before new training, and generates distinct held-out Fresh RNG streams. Study is confirmatory only for *new student samples*, not a blinded unseen teacher family.
